reviews.title: Total comfort
reviews.text: I love this bed from the start. What a great experience with the AI tracker it adjust for snoring, which I love.  The bed has so many cool features such as Bluetooth music lighting, tracking your heart rate and a whole bunch of other cool health features that will make this a great experience for anyone, especially those leaning towards comfort style and price

reviews.title: Questionable metrics
reviews.text: I’m not sure how this bed tracks your deep sleep when I wear an Apple Watch the two are consistently off. I’m not sure how this really knows your body’s health matrix when you don’t have any kind of probes sticking into you. I know the bed has sensors, but how does it really track your deep sleep. Also have a animal in the bed that could probably throw off some of the metrics. My one biggest complaint about this bed is that I was told that you could have a program to prepare for sleep with your head and legs raised, then go to a medium position and then lay flat when it’s all done. The programs that are in there, don’t seem to allow that. I wish the app would allow you to program your own settings for that since I bought the most expensive bed there was.

reviews.title: Sleep tracker

reviews.title: Wonderful but needs upgrades
reviews.text:
Love the details it provides. Do not love the alarm settings. Also wish it had a stop button on the remote for the alarm. Wish it was smart enough to realize someone got out of bed and the alarm doesn’t need to go off. 

My husbands phone will die and the bed vibrates and he has to go plug his phone in and wait for it to start up to turn off the vibrating. Or he will get up early and he’s in the shower and the bed is vibrating and I can’t cancel it. SO annoying. Also, wish it does what the salesman told us, and raised the head section with the alarm not just vibrating. 

Also, the light on the remote is crazy bright. They did so well with the light under the bed, it doesn’t wake me up but in the idle of the night if I click the remote to change something it’s SO bright!

reviews.title: Bluetooth | Adjustable Base
reviews.text: I live in an apartment complex. Someone keeps connecting to my base via bluetooth for their kindle. There is no security around bluetooth and the base is apparently in pairing mode all the time. There are no settings in the app to block other devices and also no way to permanently stop unwanted connections, just temporary workarounds … unplugging the base or keeping my phone paired at all times. I need a permanent solution as this continues to happen.
